annotations.target_phrase: Cold steel odor. Ice caressed his spine.
annotations.annotation_text: Case undergoing black-clinic neurosurgery in Chiba: the somatic terror of surgical reconstruction where his neural tissue is spliced and micro-grafted under artificial hypothermia.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 35.

sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 35.
